instruction.text: Read and listen to the short story.

atoms.text: Abasi stood at the edge of the water. He took a sip. Refreshing! He splashed some water on his face. Then he saw his friend Harold who was a hippopotamus.
atoms.sound: ssml: Ahbahsee’s World Continued. <break time='900ms'/> Ahbahsee stood at the edge of the water. He took a sip. Refreshing! He splashed some water on his face. Then he saw his friend Harold, who was a hippopotamus.

atoms.text:
“My good friend, it has been a long time! Why have you come back now?” Harold asked.

Abasi smiled, “I missed my friends. I wanted to swim here again.”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m3'> My good friend, it has been a long time! Why have you come back now?</voice> Harold asked. Ahbahsee smiled, <voice voice='m2'> I missed my friends. I wanted to swim here again.</voice>

atoms.text: Harold said, “We missed you too. You can always come to the water and refresh yourself. Until next time!” And then Harold was gone.
atoms.sound: ssml: Harold said, <voice voice='m3'> We missed you too. You can always come to the water and refresh yourself. Until next time!.</voice> And then Harold was gone.

atoms.text: Abasi stepped away from the water. He crossed the plain in moments and found himself, without knowing how, on the stone path back to his home. He entered his house.
atoms.sound: ssml: Ahbahsee stepped away from the water. He crossed the plain in moments and found himself, without knowing how, on the stone path back to his home. He entered his house.

atoms.text: “I am so happy to be home!” said Abasi. He sat with his family to eat and thought about his trip.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m2'>I am so happy to be home!</voice> said Ahbahsee. He sat with his family to eat, and thought about his trip.
